summary: Shayna paid her July 15-31 invoice the day after it was issued and stayed warm and cooperative, but spent the week re-stating boundaries she has raised many times before: no more selling private lives, no free/see-through content to non-spenders, and no posts on her OF feed. Another unauthorized feed post appeared Aug 5 (her 4th complaint on this); Fred traced it to a leftover auto-scheduler queue and disconnected it. She is prepping content for a month-long Africa volunteer trip and flagged a possible untracked fan custom on Aug 7 that was still unanswered at week close. Mood: friendly but visibly tired of repeating herself.
